info.title: Pixel art customization and movement fixes

messages.text:
"Change the pixel art style to a simpler, more stylized one (like Pokémon pixel art or similar), making it clear that there's a difference between the female and male characters, and including different types of personalization for each gender. Fix the movement animation so the legs don't move so fast, and fix the movement flexes because there are two arrows on each side of the screen that perform the same function, just leave one, and make sure it's functional. 

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Update the existing playable game with simpler, stylized pixel-art characters, clearly distinct male and female designs with gender-specific personalization, slower leg animation, and one functional on-screen movement control set.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build on the existing game and check screenshots; save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Kept the game’s Victorian mystery setting and revised the detective sprites rather than changing the overall game.
- Removed the duplicate left/right buttons, keeping a single mobile D-pad for touch movement; keyboard movement remains available.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `index.html` with distinct male/female sprite silhouettes, gender-specific outfit, hair, and accessory choices, and reduced the leg stride and animation rate.
- Removed the redundant on-screen arrows and wired touch D-pad pointer events for movement.
- JavaScript syntax check and `git diff --check` passed.
- Started the game locally and captured/read `/tmp/opencode/latest.jpg` (1280×800) while playing; no page errors were reported.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Review `index.html` diff and optionally verify gender-specific customization choices in-browser.
2. Report the implemented changes and note the assumptions made.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, character customization, rendering, movement logic, and controls.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Screenshot used: `/tmp/opencode/latest.jpg`.
